thesis: The podcast argues that a crucial shift is occurring where demand for full-stack engineers who can bridge hardware and software is rising faster than the supply of graduates in traditional engineering fields. It further posits that this transition will create new, valuable job opportunities for technicians and robot teleoperators that do not necessarily require a four-year degree.
